subject: Embed & resale economics + PS packaging for partner portals
messages:
From: Lydia Chan <lydia.chan@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Baxter <tom.baxter@edgeops.io>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 08:13:00 -0700
Subject: Potential embed partnership — Acme wants a co-branded inference module

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the intro last week. Acme Analytics is exploring embedding hosted inference into our insights product and offering it as a co-branded feature to enterprise customers. High-level asks:
- White-labeled UI/SDK so our customers see Acme branding (not Redwood)
- Revenue share vs licensing — open to either, want a sample econ split
- Support / PS packaging: onboarding, latency SLAs, and a handoff for security questionnaires
- KMS / BYOK or customer-managed keys for sensitive accounts

Tom and I sketched a short requirements doc (attached). Would love to schedule 30–45m next week to run through technical integration options and a commercial model.

Best,
Lydia

Attachments: acme_embed_requirements.pdf
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Lydia Chan <lydia.chan@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 12:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Potential embed partnership — Acme wants a co-branded inference module

Hi Lydia — great to hear from you and thanks for the brief. Happy to jump on a call.

Quick answers to help scope the meeting:
- We support both hosted API (easy) and private deployments (VPC or on-prem) for strict isolation. For a white-label SDK we typically recommend the hosted API + client SDK with co-branding on your side; we can provide a skinnable widget.
- Revenue share + committed minimums is a common pattern; we can run a model here and show unit economics.
- BYOK is supported in dedicated/private; for hosted we offer customer-managed KMS via dedicated tenancy.
- Typical PS: 2–4 week integration (SDK + SSO), optional performance tuning and on-prem packaging.

Looping in Camila (partnerships) and Jonas (integration engineering) to cover commercial and technical constraints. Can you propose 2 slots?

— Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
Tel: +1 (415) 555-0126

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Lydia Chan <lydia.chan@acmeanalytics.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Potential embed partnership — Acme wants a co-branded inference module

Thanks Lydia — excited to dig in. A couple of commercial notes before the call to make the discussion productive:
- Pricing primitives we consider: per-inference unit (token), committed throughput (reserved GPU pools) + overage rate, and OEM licensing fee for branded SDK / redistribution rights.
- Example starter structure: 60/40 revenue share (Acme/Redwood) on net revenue, or a $X/month per-seat + discounted per-token rates for customers that route through Acme. We prefer committed minimums to ensure resource predictability.
- PS packaging: Quickstart (1 week integration, $10k), Integration + SSO+KMS (3 weeks, $35k), Enterprise Turnkey (on-prem or private: 6–8 weeks, TBD).

I attached our current embed pricing deck (v2) and an annotated MPA markup for your legal team to glance at. We'll present clear options on the call.

— Camila
Camila Reyes
Partner Sales, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood_embed_pricing_v2.pdf; proposed_mpa_markup.docx
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Lydia Chan <lydia.chan@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 10:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Potential embed partnership — Acme wants a co-branded inference module

Hi all — adding some technical guardrails so the commercial ask is grounded:
- Integration paths: (A) Client SDK + Hosted API (fastest), (B) Dedicated capacity (reserved GPU cluster, single-tenant), (C) Private deployment (VPC/on-prem for highest compliance).
- Latency profile: for interactive experiences target p50 < 150ms with batching disabled; p95 depends on batch windows. If Acme wants a responsive in-product assistant we should quantify token sizes.
- Footprint for skinnable widget: ~40–60KB minified JS + 8–12KB optional localized assets.
- BYOK: supported on dedicated/private only; hosted with dedicated tenancy and KMS integration is feasible but requires an MSA addendum.
- SDK redistribution: we can ship an allowed redistribution license, but deeper white-label (removing Redwood mention) requires an OEM license + revenue share.

I'll prepare a short technical appendix for the call outlining integration steps and data flow diagrams.

— Jonas
Director, Integration Engineering
jonas.weber@redwood.com
From: Tom Baxter <tom.baxter@edgeops.io>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Lydia Chan <lydia.chan@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Potential embed partnership — Acme wants a co-branded inference module

Appreciate the breakdown — couple of items from a platform partner point of view:
- We need clearer SLO language around scheduled maintenance and fallback (can calls failover to a baseline model if Redwood capacity is constrained?).
- Data residency: some Acme enterprise customers require EU-only processing; any hosted option must support region pinning or we default to dedicated/private.
- Revenue recognition: if Acme bills end-customers, does Redwood invoice Acme monthly or will there be a direct invoicing flow?

If helpful, EdgeOps can prototype a BYOK flow on our end to validate handshake with Redwood KMS endpoints — let me know who to sync with.

— Tom
Head of Platform Partnerships, EdgeOps
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Lydia Chan <lydia.chan@acmeanalytics.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Tom Baxter <tom.baxter@edgeops.io>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Potential embed partnership — Acme wants a co-branded inference module

Thanks everyone — great momentum. Summary & next steps:
1) Schedule: propose Wed 30 Jun, 11:00–11:45 PT — 30m agenda: product scope, integration path (A/B/C), preliminary commercial preference, PS timeline.
2) Commercial preference: Camila will present 2 options (rev share vs committed seat + token rate).
3) Tech prep: Jonas to circulate the 2-page integration appendix and a short checklist for BYOK and region pinning.
4) Legal: Camila to circulate redlined MPA sections (I attached a markup). Lydia — please confirm which customers require EU-only processing so we can prepare a dedicated path if needed.

Attached: redwood_embed_pricing_v2.pdf (again) and proposed_mpa_markup.docx.

See you Wed — Hannah

Attachments: redwood_embed_pricing_v2.pdf; proposed_mpa_markup.docx
